Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

Clonotrace 1.2.1

  • Accelerated approximate clone distances by resolving clone supports once and reusing source-clone shortest-path distances across target clones. graph_clone_nn() and clone_disance(exact = FALSE) accept distance_cache_mb (default 64 MiB per worker); larger source matrices fall back to the existing target-clone blocks. Set it to 0 to disable distance caching. The nearest-neighbor statistic is unchanged.
  • Made clone-specific local distance rescaling optional and disabled it by default. Set local_rescale = TRUE in revise_clone_distance() or clone_disance() to recover the 1.2.0 behavior. The unscaled input clone geometry is otherwise retained up to a global median normalization.
  • Added a disk-backed exact-OT workflow through build_graph_distance_store() and graph_clone_ot_disk(). Cell-graph shortest-path distances are written in resumable row blocks, and exact OT reads bounded cost blocks instead of retaining the complete distance matrix in memory. Source-clone work can be split across a configured future plan, and validated per-source checkpoints can be reused across interrupted runs. This preserves the exact graph-Wasserstein objective; it reduces peak RAM and repeated work but still requires quadratic disk space in the number of stored endpoint cells.
  • Made the disk-backed workflow the implementation used by clone_disance(exact = TRUE). The former dense implementation remains available as exact_backend = "memory" for small legacy reproductions.

Clonotrace 1.2.0

  • Fixed the internal multiresolution Leiden ladder to accept numeric membership vectors returned by current igraph releases while retaining integer cluster identifiers. This restores automatic centroid-weight selection in revise_clone_distance() when clusters is not supplied.

  • Added revise_clone_distance(): local density rescaling of the original clone distance followed by an optional blend with clone-centroid distance. The automatic centroid weight is selected without fate or cell-type labels by agreement with multiresolution RNA-cluster-composition differences.

  • Made the revised distance the default output of clone_disance(). The raw exact-OT or approximate distance is retained in dis_clonotrace; set revised = FALSE for the pre-1.2 behavior.

  • Added support for observed clone identities, probability-weighted clone centroids, within-sample weight selection, fixed-weight ablations, named or positional long-form clone identifiers, and auditable selection attributes.

  • Made the HDF5-backed blocked implementation the default backend of label_spreading_bootstrap(). The legacy dense backend remains available as backend = "dense", and caller-owned HDF5 reference caches are preserved.

  • Added regression tests for revised-distance construction, clone_disance() integration, blocked-bootstrap dispatch, and HDF5-cache ownership.

  • Made the external-data tutorial non-executing during package builds, so clean checks do not depend on an unbundled hematopoiesis.rds file.

Clonotrace 1.1.2

  • Fixed SNN similarity-to-shortest-path cost conversion. igraph::set_edge_attr() returns a modified graph and does not mutate the input graph in place, so the returned graph is now assigned explicitly. Larger shared-neighbor overlap now correctly produces shorter traversal costs through exp(-overlap).
  • Versioned cell-graph checkpoints with an explicit edge-cost transform so checkpoints created with untransformed SNN similarities are not reused.

Clonotrace 1.1.1

  • Fixed long2square() conversion and added explicit validation for malformed, duplicate, or conflicting pairwise inputs.
  • Corrected clone-distance checkpoint reuse, added parameter/input validation, atomic checkpoint writes, and separate exact/approximate result files.
  • Added conservative safeguards before large exact clone-distance calculations.
  • Removed Leiden clustering’s dependence on ambiguous S4 dist dispatch and preserved clone identifiers in clustering output.
  • Made cell_clone_prob an explicit argument to cell_clone_coembed().
  • Added clean-session regression tests and continuous-integration workflows.

Clonotrace 1.1.0

  • Added memory-efficient blocked label spreading (label_spreading_blocked, label_spreading_bootstrap_blocked) with optional HDF5 streaming.
  • Added HDF5 helper utilities: create_hdf5_matrix, normalize_hdf5_rows.
  • Added clone_dpt for clone-level diffusion pseudotime inference.
  • Added cell_clone_coembed for clone-aware cell-cell coembedding.
  • Added soft_cluster_gam_fit and profile_cluster_DEG for pseudotime-aware differential expression analysis.
  • Added cluster_profile_enrich for permutation-based profile enrichment testing.
  • Added leiden_embedding and leiden_dis for graph-based clustering.
  • Various utility functions for sparse matrix manipulation, kNN graph construction, and optimal transport-based clone distances.

Clonotrace 1.0.0

  • Initial release.
